subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes, including storage location, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause propagation?
rationale: The security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, and whether the audit belongs in memory-core, a plugin SDK seam, or an external bundle; source inspection shows the gap but not the product contract.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the event schema, storage, integrity, and redaction model before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader persistence provenance
options.body: Track the remaining work under a broader durable-state provenance design if maintainers want one architecture for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: Externalize until core seam is needed
options.body: Defer core changes if maintainers decide existing plugin or MCP packages are sufficient without a new OpenClaw memory-audit contract.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the event schema, storage, integrity, and redaction model before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this as first-class memory/security design and has recent adjacent memory/security product history.
